TimeseriesCoreBars reads usage and limit live from the timeseries store (mirroring TimeseriesGauge's data plumbing) and renders them as quantised utilisation bars via {@link ProgressBars}. Usage and limit flow through each series' optional `transform`; the hover card summarises current/min/max/avg/ capacity over the look-back window.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/TimeseriesCoreBars.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { TimeseriesCoreBars } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/data";
```
